notes: Corrects the remote voice regression in 1.9.19. Hey Jarvis wake detection now keeps model reset under exclusive ownership, ignores stale results during audio reloads, and reports model readiness without waiting for microphone frames. The phone plays a short pleasant confirmation chime only after the server detects the wake phrase. Silent browser AudioWorklet capture automatically falls back to compatibility mode, failed capture is shown clearly, and rapid retries cannot leave stale microphones or sockets active. Manual start and post-chime speech continue to reach the private provider session.
